name: 幽冥眼
habitat: 暗影灵面 32级进化（睁闭眼看时间）
habitatEn: Evolves from Anyinglingmian at Lv.32 (form depends on time of day)
evolution: 小灵面 → 暗影灵面 Lv.20 → 幽冥眼 Lv.32
description: 传说幽冥眼一族在生命终结的时候能窥见生命与宇宙的奥秘。对灵魂与星辰抱有极其虔诚的信仰，面具上刻着的眼睛形状图腾似乎象征着种族的信仰。
descriptionEn: Legend has it that the Youmingyan clan can glimpse the mysteries of life and the universe when their lives come to an end. They hold an extremely devout faith in souls and stars; the eye-shaped totem carved on the mask seems to symbolize the faith of the species.

skills.name: 鬼火
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, self recovers 1 energy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.name: 许愿星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 取念
skills.description: 每回合随机变成敌方任意精灵的技能，且该技能能耗-2。
skills.descriptionEn: Each turn, randomly becomes a skill of any of the enemy's spirits, and that skill's energy cost -2.

skills.name: 幽灵爆发
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 魔镜
skills.description: 敌方获得魔防-50%，且失去3能量。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains Magic Defense -50% and loses 3 energy.

skills.name: 聒噪
skills.description: 敌方获得全攻击技能能耗+2，持续3回合。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains all attack skills energy cost +2, lasting 3 turns.

skills.name: 报复
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：敌方失去3能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks: the enemy loses 3 energy.

skills.name: 背袭
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若敌方能量等于0，造成20倍伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if the enemy's energy equals 0, deals 20 times damage.

skills.name: 嘲弄
skills.description: 自己获得魔攻+90%，若敌方本回合更换精灵，自己获得速度+70。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +90% magic attack; if the enemy switches spirits this turn, self gains Speed +70.

skills.name: 恐吓
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 降灵
skills.descriptionEn: Inflicts 1 stack of Spirit Descent Mark on the enemy.

skills.name: 恶作剧
skills.description: 敌方失去3能量，应对防御：改为敌方失去6能量。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy loses 3 energy; countering defense: the enemy loses 6 energy instead.
